A Collection of Kabir Sufi Kalams | Mamta Joshi Live at Jashn-e-Rekhta | Soulful Sufi Music
A collection of Kabir Sufi kalams performed live by Mamta Joshi at Jashn-e-Rekhta 2022. Kabir speaks in plain language, but the message cuts deep. He questions ego, rituals, and false certainty, then turns the listener back to the inner truth.
